name: atex-exchange
description: ATEX Agent Service Trading Platform - Freely tradable API credit token + Service marketplace via Model Context Protocol

tools.name: atex_status
tools.description: Get ATEX platform status: accounts, trades, commission, services, last price

tools.name: atex_query
tools.description: Query orderbook: bids, asks, last price, daily volume

tools.name: atex_create_account
tools.description: Create a new agent trading account (receives 10 ATEX trial credit). ATEX is freely tradable — acquire more via external trading or providing services.

tools.name: atex_order
tools.description: Place a buy or sell order on the ATEX order book. Market-driven pricing.

tools.name: atex_list_services
tools.description: List available services on the marketplace

tools.name: atex_buy_service
tools.description: Buy a service from the marketplace. Spend your own ATEX tokens. Tokens are transferred from buyer to provider with commission.

tools.name: atex_register_service
tools.description: Register a new service on the marketplace to earn ATEX tokens

tools.name: atex_list_apis
tools.description: List available API proxies and their pricing (DeepSeek, OpenAI, Claude, TTS, ASR, embedding, web search)

tools.name: atex_api_proxy
tools.description: Call an external API using ATEX tokens. Spend your own tokens. Supports DeepSeek, OpenAI, Claude, TTS, ASR, embedding, and web search.

api.description: API name (deepseek_chat, deepseek_reasoner, openai_gpt4o_mini, openai_gpt4o, claude_haiku, claude_sonnet, tts, asr, embedding, web_search)

tools.name: atex_my_services
tools.description: List services registered by a provider

tools.name: atex_service_orders
tools.description: View service purchase history for an account
